scope: Final offline browser visual acceptance only; not live product acceptance or source/mathematical review.

observations.layout: Single centered reading column with consistent paragraph alignment and clear section spacing. Both figures and their captions fit without apparent clipping or incoherent overlap.
observations.formulas: Inline symbols, subscripts and displayed equations are rendered and visually readable; no raw TeX or apparent formula clipping is visible. This is a display observation, not a mathematical correctness review.
observations.readability: Heading, prose, figure labels and captions are distinguishable. The full-page screenshot was resized by the image viewer; no additional image or crop was opened.
observations.navigation_regions: The bottom exercises navigation control is visible and separated from the prose. The checker completed the text-to-exercises navigation assertion before the later failure.
observations.option_controls: Not applicable to the text view; choice screenshots and control assertions were not reached.

unreviewed_views.reason: Checker failed at the exercise-number assertion before screenshot capture.

findings.diagnosis: The .no locator uses allTextContents(), which reads textContent. For exercise numbers 299 through 302, the saved HTML contains the number in hidden KaTeX MathML, the application/x-tex annotation, and the visible katex-html span. Removing non-digits concatenates those three representations. The CSS explicitly hides katex-mathml. This explains the assertion mismatch without establishing any visible exercise-layout defect.
findings.required_authorization: Parent authorization for the affected technical repair is required before any --resume run.

evidence.role: exercise offline HTML used for read-only diagnosis
